name: Yandex voice-over translation

description: Replaces com.osp.app.signin with com.notsamsung.dummy in dex and routes account lookups through Android AccountManager instead of Samsung Account's provider.
name: Bypass Samsung Account provider checks

description: Bypass Knox, root, warranty bit, and SAK checks so Samsung Health runs on Knox-tripped devices (0x1) without root.
name: Disable Knox integrity checks

description: Routes the AAudio calls of Vr4pMediaPlayer and its audio runnable through the bundled 5.1-channel bridge, initializes the bridge in Main4XActivity and refreshes the subtitle style on the playback-speed tick for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending.
name: 5.1-channel audio bridge (4XVR)

description: Rewrites native Oculus face/eye permission checks to the Android XR names, on exact 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968 and 2.0.22/5002244 builds.
name: Android XR native permission names

description: Legacy overlay fallback for older builds: adds SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW and the compositor signal window.
name: Appear on top (legacy)

description: Installs the bundled 5.1-channel AAudio bridge native for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022.
name: Audio bridge payload (4XVR)

description: Adds static blue noise after video colour processing and fade, on the background/base layer only; 8-bit or 10-bit input, always 8-bit sRGB output. Selectable per layer, but turn OLED's VD-like fovea options off when combining. Unknown host shaders pass through unchanged.
name: Background blue-noise dithering (experimental)

options.description: Both choices apply the same final 8-bit output quantizer. This describes your stream; it does not change host negotiation or decoder precision. When combining with OLED calibration, leave both of its existing VD-like fovea toggles off.
options.title: Declared input depth

description: Renames the package and Steam Link's internal VR-launch component, so the patched app can be installed next to the original.
name: Change package name

options.description: Accepts either a full Java package name (for example, com.valvesoftware.steamlinkvr.galaxyxr) or a display suffix (for example, Galaxy XR). Suffix input appends to app name and generates a package suffix automatically.
options.title: Package name

description: Routes controller vibration to the grip vibrator instead of the trigger, which Galaxy XR uses for every OpenXR vibration. The grip one needs shell rights, so this needs Shizuku running with its permission granted to Steam Link; without it vibration is stock.
name: Controller grip haptics through Shizuku (experimental)

description: Makes the Galaxy XR runtime extrapolate controller poses to the time VRLink asks, instead of repeating one sample per display frame, and filters jitter out of the streamed pose. Adds an OpenXR API layer; no Steam Link code changes.
name: Controller pose extrapolation (experimental)

description: Takes controller poses straight from the Galaxy XR controller HAL instead of the OpenXR runtime, removing the runtime's ~35 ms sample lag, and filters jitter out of pose and velocity. The HAL needs shell rights, so this needs Shizuku running with its permission granted to Steam Link; without Shizuku tracking stays as it is. Steam Link 2.0.23: angular velocity is reported local to the grip pose.
name: Controller tracking from the controller HAL through Shizuku (experimental)

description: Takes controller poses straight from the Galaxy XR controller HAL instead of the OpenXR runtime, removing the runtime's ~35 ms sample lag, and filters jitter out of pose and velocity. The HAL needs shell rights, so this needs Shizuku running with its permission granted to Steam Link; without Shizuku tracking stays as it is. Steam Link 2.0.20 - 2.0.22: angular velocity is reported in the base space.
name: Controller tracking from the controller HAL through Shizuku, 2.0.20 - 2.0.22 (experimental)

description: Derives controller linear and angular velocity from grip/aim pose history, and can cut VRLink's 4 controller pose sends per display frame to 2 or 1.
name: Controller velocity fix

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+32 (int64 ns = value×1e6). Falls back to runtime velocity when pose samples are farther apart. Allowed range: 5 to 100 ms.
options.title: Maximum sample gap (ms)

options.description: libvrlink_scene.so QSVLClient::OnTopOfFrame: selects four, two, or one evenly phased controller pose sends per display frame. Actual send Hz equals display Hz multiplied by 4, 2, or 1. Stock preserves Valve behavior.
options.title: Controller pose-send cadence

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+48 (float32 EMA weight). 0 = no smoothing, minimum lag; higher values reduce jitter. Allowed range: 0.0 to 0.9.
options.title: Derived velocity smoothing

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+40 (float32 m/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived linear speed. Allowed range: 1 to 50 m/s.
options.title: Maximum linear speed (m/s)

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+44 (float32 rad/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived angular speed. Allowed range: 1 to 100 rad/s.
options.title: Maximum angular speed (rad/s)

description: Rotates the controller velocities the Galaxy XR runtime reports into the frames SteamVR reads, so thrown objects leave in the right direction. Stock, they arrive in a controller-attached frame. Adds an OpenXR API layer; no Steam Link code is changed. Steam Link 2.0.23: angular velocity is reported local to the streamed pose.
name: Controller velocity frame (experimental)

description: Rotates the controller velocities the Galaxy XR runtime reports into the frames SteamVR reads, so thrown objects leave in the right direction. Stock, they arrive in a controller-attached frame. Adds an OpenXR API layer; no Steam Link code is changed. Steam Link 2.0.20 - 2.0.22: angular velocity is reported in the base space.
name: Controller velocity frame, 2.0.20 - 2.0.22 (experimental)

description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR. Recommended: Meta Quest Pro on the legacy targets through 5002244, Galaxy XR otherwise. Explicit profiles override that. Optional on 2.0.23/5002363.
name: Device identity

options.description: Recommended uses Meta Quest Pro on exact legacy bundle targets through 5002244 (including 5001712), and Galaxy XR otherwise. Explicit profiles override that choice. Native-XR routing and verified legacy payloads are preserved.
options.title: HMD identity

name: Force HMD initialization gates

description: Bypasses the permission-state gate in XrSceneLobby, on exact 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968 and 2.0.22/5002244 builds.

description: Bypasses the 3 XR gates in the stream path, on exact 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968 and 2.0.22/5002244 builds.

description: Adds static blue noise after video colour processing and fade, on the foveal layer only; 8-bit or 10-bit input, always 8-bit sRGB output. Selectable per layer, but turn OLED's VD-like fovea options off when combining. Unknown host shaders pass through unchanged.
name: Foveal blue-noise dithering (experimental)

options.description: Both choices apply the same final 8-bit output quantizer. This describes your stream; it does not change host negotiation or decoder precision. When combining with OLED calibration, leave both of its existing VD-like fovea toggles off.

description: Drains the render dispatch queue before every frame, hands scene switches to RenderDispatch.requestScene instead of the retired render runnable, and routes window teardown through the dispatch for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending.

name: Galaxy XR high-resolution 3-projection fix

description: Installs the Khronos OpenXR loader 1.1.58, the 4XVR view-config API layer and the Galaxy XR manifest declarations for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Decoded-base adaptation; headset validation pending.

dependencies: Startup splash and XR launch mode (before 5002322)

name: Galaxy XR legacy foundation (through 2.0.22/5002244)

dependencies: Startup splash and XR launch mode (before 5002322)
description: Applies the 17-patch Galaxy XR set for exact 2.0.20/5001712: startup permissions and splash, Meta Quest Pro identity, high-resolution fix and the tested balanced OLED profile.
name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.20/5001712)

dependencies: Startup splash and XR launch mode (before 5002322)
description: Applies the same 17-patch set as 5001712, for exact 2.0.20/5001812. Headset validation pending.
name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.20/5001812)

dependencies: Startup splash and XR launch mode (before 5002322)
description: Applies the same 17-patch set as 5001712, for exact 2.0.21/5001968. Headset validation pending.

description: Clamps the InitializeDevice refresh-rate picker floors (121.0f/91.0f -> 73.0f) so exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022 requests Galaxy XR's 72 Hz mode. Three guarded bytes in libvr4p-oculus.so; runtime application pending headset validation.
name: Galaxy XR refresh profile (72 Hz, 4XVR)

description: Selects the 8-patch Galaxy XR set for exact 4XVR 2.0.22/20022: launch compatibility, controller models, the 72 Hz refresh profile, the libplacebo HDR pipeline, the 5.1-channel audio bridge, the frame-synced render dispatch, the subtitle suite and the startup/UI continuity helper. Gated on a pristine 2.0.22/20022 source APK and libplacebo source availability; headset validation pending.
name: Galaxy XR set (4XVR 2.0.22/20022)

description: Installs libgxr_face_bridge.so, mapping XR_FB_face_tracking2 to XR_ANDROID_face_tracking, and adds FACE_TRACKING to the manifest on builds up to 5002318. Feeds the Galaxy XR VRCFT module.
name: GXR face bridge (version 5002318 and below)

description: Adds Galaxy XR tongue out/left/right/up/down on exact 2.0.23/5002363, keeping Valve's native face expressions and standard TongueOut, for the Galaxy XR VRCFT module.
name: GXR tongue bridge (version 5002322 and above)

description: Installs the modified libplacebo 7.360.1 (LGPL-2.1-or-later), the 4XVR HDR bridge native and the bundled open-source notices for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022.
name: HDR pipeline payload (4XVR)

description: Loads the HDR bridge, routes the decoder output surface through it for the FP16 hand-off, detects HLG from the video MediaFormat and keeps the bridge informed of movie/seek transitions for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending.
name: libplacebo HDR pipeline (4XVR)

description: Stubs the 11 exported Oculus platform-init/entitlement/message functions in libovrplatformloader.so of exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. The reference Galaxy XR build requires the Meta platform channel to stay inert on a non-Meta runtime; launch-criticality is unproven and Meta-store VIP flows degrade. Default off; verify on device before enabling.
name: Meta platform decoupling (4XVR, experimental)
